ctx.x: Sara Lou Harris. I worked on a puppet show, piano quartet. I was at the (?) with Lionel Meth(?), who was Max Meth's(?) son. Another boy from Louisiana, (?)Wilson DeNiro(?), a (?) pianist. We played at Monte Prose's(?) La Vie En Rose -- I called it Rose Levine.
